ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: Geometric Flows PREREQS: Working knowledge of measure-theoretical probability, basic exposure to differential and/or Riemannian geometry. DESCRIPTION: This course aims to study the geometric and dynamic aspects of complex systems. Tentative topics may include: geometric partial differential equations, minimal surfaces, geometry of level sets, high-dimensional convex geometry, concentration of measures, stochastic calculus, optimal transport, functional inequalities.
